name: @veranoapp/linkonda-mcp
description: MCP server for Linkonda — create and manage short links and QR-ready URLs without per-visitor tracking.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && node scripts/nested.mjs raycast typecheck && node scripts/nested.mjs zapier typecheck
scripts.lint: node scripts/nested.mjs raycast check build && node scripts/nested.mjs zapier build
scripts.test: vitest run --dir src && node scripts/nested.mjs raycast test && node scripts/nested.mjs zapier test
